{{Otheruses|Yellow Squadron}}
'''Yellow Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] assigned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Impending Doom]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were deployed in an effort to stop the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' from leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
